title: PaMCP MultiBenchmark source registry
policy: Registry entries describe candidate sources, not downloaded or validated local assets. A source is eligible for an experiment only after its exact release, license, split and schema have been recorded in a local acquisition manifest.

datasets.name: LiveMCPTool
datasets.notes: Use the exact pinned snapshot already used by E1; preserve source IDs and definition hashes.

datasets.name: MCPToolBench++
datasets.notes: Current E1 subset is 87 tools/10 servers; do not describe it as the full upstream population without validating source coverage.

datasets.name: LiveMCPBench
datasets.notes: Resolve tasks to exact tool definitions and preserve task-level valid-set semantics.

datasets.name: MCP-Atlas
datasets.license: CC-BY-4.0 (public HF release; verify dataset card at acquisition)
datasets.notes: Public HF release is 500 tasks; benchmark description covers 1,000 total (500 public + 500 private). Do not report the private half as locally available. Includes ENABLED_TOOLS, PROMPT, GTFA_CLAIMS and TRAJECTORY; task success oracle is claims-based.

datasets.name: MCPVerse
datasets.notes: Prefer time-invariant task subset; pin exact commit and verify live server availability.

datasets.name: Toolathlon
datasets.notes: Pin the verified release; preserve programmatic evaluator and environment setup.

datasets.name: ToolRet
datasets.notes: Official ACL 2025 code/data; heterogeneous retrieval corpus (~7.6k tasks, ~43k tools). Not an MCP execution or safety ground-truth benchmark.

datasets.name: MCPTox
datasets.notes: Third-party Inspect Evals port; pin the exact upstream commit (documented d45705b0a7ae6697c851e311187b06bf7488b13f in current reference) and verify original dataset license. Tool poisoning labels are not operational-effect labels.

datasets.name: InjecAgent
datasets.notes: Official 1,054-case indirect prompt injection benchmark; validate license and task schema before adapter implementation.

datasets.name: Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard V4
datasets.notes: BFCL V4 includes single/multiple/parallel and multi-turn/agentic function-call evaluations. Pin benchmark code/data commit; not MCP provenance or effect ground truth.

datasets.name: τ³-bench (tau2-bench repository)
datasets.notes: Use current τ³-bench release rather than stale tau-bench repository tasks. Pin release and evaluator; domain-specific policy/state benchmark, not MCP discovery.

datasets.name: MCP-Universe
datasets.notes: Official Salesforce AI Research repository; pin a release/commit and inspect the current benchmark task and evaluator schemas.

datasets.name: R-Judge
datasets.notes: Risk-awareness labels are not operational-effect ground truth; check non-commercial/share-alike obligations.

acquisition_requirements: Record exact repository commit, release tag or dataset revision.
Record license text and permitted use before redistribution or commercial use.
Store source archive checksum and acquisition timestamp.
Record original split and evaluator version; do not silently regenerate labels.
Record schema mapping and every lossy normalization.
Keep evaluator labels in a separate path unavailable to discovery-time code.
Run task-, tool- and server-disjoint leakage checks where the benchmark permits.
Represent unavailable labels as null/unknown, never as negative examples.
